title: "Hi, I'm Xinyan Xu"

Welcome to my personal website!

I am an M.S. student in **Biostatistics** (Public Health Data Science track) 
at the Columbia University Mailman School of Public Health. I received my 
B.S. in Applied Statistics from Shanghai Lixin University of Accounting and 
Finance.

My interests lie at the intersection of statistics, epidemiology, and 
machine learning. I have worked on projects such as forecasting hepatitis B 
incidence in China using ARIMA and LSTM models, and studying the association 
between diabetes and dementia across BMI groups using large-scale data.

On this site you can find:

* My [resume](resume.html), with my education, research, and work experience
* An [interactive dashboard](dashboard.html) I built using R, `plotly`, and 
  `flexdashboard`

Feel free to reach out by [email](mailto:ava202407@outlook.com) or check out my
